name: build
title: world.build
lead: The same value, written in code instead of read from a file. `{ detail = 2 }`: coordinates are half blocks, fitted to slabs and stairs.
signature: world.build(fn: (b: Builder) -> (), opts: { detail: number ? }?) → Schematic

usedIn.quote: `world.build` makes a build in code: a schematic with no file. It gets a
world.build(function(b) end, { detail = 1 })   -- the same value, written in code; detail 2 is half blocks
detail = 1,                        -- as world.build: 1, or 2 for half blocks
build = function(b) ... end,       -- exactly a world.build function
